scores.critique: The glossy pink thermometer reads more like a polished habit/fintech widget than the chat rail's restrained performer cockpit language. Its oversized radius, heavy progress fill, and roomy hero-card composition break the one-ink, bare-text, hairline-restraint DNA.

The warmth and candy energy are close, but the big saturated gradient bar, oversized radius, and glossy chip make it read like a polished progress widget rather than the chat rail's restrained performer cockpit. It needs the same one-ink opacity ladder and hairline restraint instead of broad effects carrying the design.

This reads as a polished fintech progress card, not a performer cockpit panel with chat-rail energy. The oversized round card, centered KPI, and generic progress meter miss the bare-text restraint, off-round tuning, and playful motion cues of the anchor.

The panel has warmth and candy energy, but it leans hard into AI-default pill stacking: title pill, token pill, percent pill, next pill, and rounded progress capsules all compete with the chat rail's bare-text restraint. The bright pink filled segment bar makes the accent feel like the product skin instead of one restrained performer-facing action.

feedback.text: v2 but kill the milestone dots, too busy
